resources.string: Overlay permission is required for the car screen

Setup:
1. Tap the button above and allow "Display over other apps".
2. Android Auto app on the phone: tap the version string 10 times to unlock Developer Mode.
3. Overflow menu, Developer settings, turn on Unknown sources.
4. Reconnect the phone to the car. Road Class appears under the navigation apps.

The TV site has bigger tap targets. The mobile site handles sign-in better. Try both.
